main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (next-24-bar return minus coin's mean 24-bar return), non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 500 non-overlapping cases

supporting_check.name: mean product, top third |forecast| minus bottom third

decided_by: The mean is positive with t >= 2, and the largest-|forecast| third beats the smallest third.
reading: The coin's mean 24-bar return is taken over its non-overlapping grid samples in all windows; the thirds are the floor(n/3) cases with the largest and smallest |forecast| (stable sort); fewer than 500 cases is reported as 'not observable' as instructed; the situation side uses the in-window price 24-bar return, and the raw component value where the window has fewer than 24 prior bars.
